messages.context: Mayor Cole 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Oi, mining is tough, but has t'be done!
messages.text: Oi, mining is tough, but has t'be done!
messages.zh: 喂,挖矿虽辛苦,但总得有人干!

messages.context: Mayor Cole 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: I'm no different than yu' pal, I just work twice as hard!
messages.text: I'm no different than yu' pal, I just work twice as hard!
messages.zh: 我跟你没啥两样,伙计,不过是加倍卖力罢了!

messages.context: Mayor Cole 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Nothin' is more satisfying, than a full inventory after a day of work!
messages.text: Nothin' is more satisfying, than a full inventory after a day of work!
messages.zh: 苦干一天后装满整个背包,没啥比这更痛快了!

messages.context: Mayor Cole 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: Some people mine to forget, I mine to remember.
messages.text: Some people mine to forget, I mine to remember.
messages.zh: 有人靠挖矿遗忘,我靠挖矿铭记。

messages.context: Mayor Cole 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: A good pickaxe, is a swinging pickaxe!
messages.text: A good pickaxe, is a swinging pickaxe!
